title: Taiwan Stocks Plunge 4.51% as TSMC Hits Its Daily Limit
summaryHi: ताइवान का शेयर बाज़ार 4.51% गिरा, TSMC निचली सीमा पर पहुँचा
summaryEs: La bolsa de Taiwán se desploma un 4,51 % y TSMC cae hasta su límite diario
summaryJa: 台湾株が4.51％急落、TSMCはストップ安
summaryEn: Taiwan's stock market fell 4.51% on Friday, its biggest intraday point drop ever, as TSMC hit limit down.
paragraphs: Taiwan's stock market endured a dramatic sell-off on Friday, with the benchmark Taiex plunging a record 3,737.67 points within minutes of the opening bell. The index briefly sank to 37,837.05, well below the psychologically important 40,000 mark and under its 240-day moving average.

The slump came after steep losses on Wall Street and in the Japanese and South Korean markets. Investors are increasingly uncertain about how policies on artificial intelligence data centres might change following the US midterm elections, and Taiwan, as a key supplier of AI chips, is particularly exposed.

TSMC, which accounts for more than 40% of the market's capitalisation, fell by the maximum daily limit to NT$2,020, its biggest one-day price drop on record. That wiped roughly NT$5.7 trillion off its market value. Several other heavyweights, including MediaTek, Delta Electronics and ASE Technology, also hit limit down, while Hon Hai lost more than 9%.
Prices recovered partially as the session went on, and the Taiex closed 1,873.08 points, or 4.51%, lower at 39,701.64. Turnover was heavy at NT$1.25 trillion.

Analysts cautioned that a wave of margin calls could force investors who had bought shares with borrowed money to sell. They recommended waiting for technical signs of stabilisation before buying again.
Taiwan's stock market had a very bad day on Friday. Share prices fell fast in the morning.
Just after the market opened, the main index lost 3,737 points. This was the biggest fall in one morning in its history.
Why? On Thursday, share prices in New York fell a lot. Prices in Japan and South Korea also went down. Many people are worried about what will happen to AI computer centres after the US elections.
TSMC is Taiwan's biggest company. Its share price fell 10%, the most it can fall in one day. Other big tech companies also fell.
Later, prices went up a little. At the end of the day, the index was down 4.51%. Experts say people should wait and not sell in a hurry.

市場一開盤，主要指數就跌了3,737點。
這是史上單一早上跌最多的一次。
為什麼？
星期四，紐約的股價大跌。
日本和南韓的股價也下跌。
很多人擔心美國選舉後，AI電腦中心會怎麼樣。
台積電是台灣最大的公司。
它的股價跌了10%，這是一天能跌的最大幅度。
其他大型科技公司也下跌了。
後來，股價回升了一點。
收盤時，指數下跌了4.51%。
專家說大家應該等一等，不要急著賣。

paragraphs: Taiwan's stock market had one of its worst days ever on Friday. Within minutes of the 9 o'clock opening, the main index, the Taiex, dropped 3,737.67 points and fell below 40,000. It was the largest fall during a single trading day in the market's history.

The sell-off followed heavy losses on Wall Street and sharp falls in Japan and South Korea. Investors around the world are unsure about future policies on AI data centres after the US midterm elections. Because Taiwan makes many of the chips used in AI, its market was hit especially hard.

Chipmaker TSMC, which makes up more than 40% of the market's total value, fell by the daily limit of 10% to NT$2,020. In a few minutes, the company lost about NT$5.7 trillion in value. MediaTek, Delta Electronics and ASE also hit their limits, and Hon Hai dropped more than 9%.
The market won back some of its losses later in the day. It closed down 1,873.08 points, or 4.51%, at 39,701.64. Trading was very busy, worth NT$1.25 trillion.
Analysts warned that more selling could come from people who borrowed money to buy shares. They advised investors to wait for clear signs that the market has become stable.

這波賣壓緊跟在華爾街重挫以及日本和南韓股市大跌之後。
全球投資人對美國期中選舉後AI資料中心的未來政策感到不確定。
因為台灣生產許多AI使用的晶片，台股受創特別嚴重。
佔整體市值超過四成的晶片製造商台積電，跌停10%至新台幣2,020元。
短短幾分鐘內，該公司市值蒸發約新台幣5.7兆元。
聯發科、台達電和日月光也都跌停，鴻海則下跌超過9%。
當天稍晚，市場收復部分跌幅。
交易非常熱絡，成交金額達新台幣1.25兆元。
分析師警告，借錢買股的人可能會帶來更多賣壓。
他們建議投資人等到市場出現明確的穩定跡象再說。

佔市值四成以上的台積電跌停至新台幣2,020元，是史上最大的單日股價跌幅。
這讓它的市值蒸發約新台幣5.7兆元。

paragraphs: Taiwan's equity market was thrown into turmoil on Friday as the Taiex shed an unprecedented 3,737.67 points in the opening minutes of trading, the steepest intraday point decline in its history. At its low of 37,837.05, the index had slipped not only beneath the 40,000 threshold but also below its 240-day moving average, a level many traders regard as long-term support.

The rout was triggered by heavy overnight losses on Wall Street, compounded by sharp declines in Tokyo and Seoul. Underlying the jitters is mounting uncertainty over the direction of policy on artificial intelligence data centres in the wake of the US midterm elections, a concern that weighs disproportionately on Taiwan given its central role in the AI supply chain.

TSMC, whose shares represent more than 40% of the market's total capitalisation, was locked at limit down at NT$2,020, a record single-session fall of NT$220 that erased around NT$5.7 trillion of its market value. Fellow heavyweights MediaTek, Delta Electronics, ASE Technology and Nanya Technology suffered the same fate, while Hon Hai tumbled by more than 9%.
Although buyers returned later in the day, trimming the losses, the benchmark still closed 1,873.08 points, or 4.51%, lower at 39,701.64, on turnover of NT$1.25 trillion.

Market analysts warned that the slide could set off a wave of margin calls, compelling leveraged investors to liquidate their holdings. They urged caution, advising investors to wait for technical indicators confirming that the market has stabilised.
sentZh: 台灣股市星期五陷入一片混亂，加權指數在開盤幾分鐘內重挫史無前例的3,737.67點，是台股史上最大的盤中點數跌幅。
指數在最低點37,837.05點時，不僅跌破40,000點關卡，也跌破許多交易員視為長期支撐的240日移動平均線。
這波崩跌由華爾街前一晚的重挫引發，又因東京和首爾股市大跌而雪上加霜。
恐慌背後是美國期中選舉後人工智慧資料中心政策走向的不確定性日益升高，而由於台灣在AI供應鏈中扮演核心角色，這項憂慮對台灣的衝擊格外沉重。
股票佔市場總市值四成以上的台積電鎖死跌停於新台幣2,020元，單日下跌新台幣220元創下紀錄，市值蒸發約新台幣5.7兆元。
同為權值股的聯發科、台達電、日月光投控和南亞科也同樣跌停，鴻海則重挫逾9%。
雖然買盤在當天稍晚回籠、跌幅收斂，加權指數仍收跌1,873.08點，跌幅4.51%，收在39,701.64點，成交金額新台幣1.25兆元。
市場分析師警告，這波下跌可能引發一連串追繳保證金，迫使融資投資人出脫持股。
他們呼籲謹慎，建議投資人等待技術指標確認市場止穩。

paragraphs: Taiwan's stock market experienced an extraordinary collapse on Friday morning, when the Taiex plummeted by a record 3,737.67 points shortly after trading commenced. This represented the largest intraday decline in points that the market has ever recorded, and it briefly pushed the index well below the symbolically significant level of 40,000.

Market observers linked the sell-off to a combination of external factors. Substantial losses on Wall Street were followed by steep falls in Japan and South Korea, as investors grew apprehensive about the future of policies affecting artificial intelligence data centres after the US midterm elections. Since Taiwan's economy relies heavily on exporting AI-related semiconductors, its market proved especially vulnerable.

The impact was most pronounced on TSMC, which constitutes over 40% of the market's overall value. Its shares fell by the maximum permitted amount to NT$2,020, eliminating approximately NT$5.7 trillion in market capitalisation. A number of other leading firms, among them MediaTek and Delta Electronics, likewise hit their daily limits.
The market subsequently regained some ground, ultimately closing 4.51% lower at 39,701.64, with turnover reaching a substantial NT$1.25 trillion.

Commentators cautioned that the decline might trigger further forced selling by investors who had purchased shares using borrowed funds. Consequently, they recommended that investors remain patient until there is clear evidence that conditions have stabilised.
sentZh: 台灣股市星期五早上出現驚人的崩跌，加權指數在開盤後不久便重挫創紀錄的3,737.67點。
這是台股有史以來最大的盤中點數跌幅，並使指數一度遠低於具有象徵意義的40,000點。
市場觀察人士將這波拋售歸因於多項外部因素。
華爾街大幅下跌之後，日本和南韓股市也跟著重挫，因為投資人對美國期中選舉後影響人工智慧資料中心的政策走向感到憂慮。
由於台灣經濟高度依賴出口AI相關半導體，台股顯得特別脆弱。
受衝擊最明顯的是佔整體市值四成以上的台積電。
其股價以允許的最大幅度下跌至新台幣2,020元，市值蒸發約新台幣5.7兆元。
聯發科和台達電等多家其他龍頭企業也同樣觸及跌停。
市場隨後收復部分失土，最終收跌4.51%，收在39,701.64點，成交金額高達新台幣1.25兆元。
評論人士提醒，這波下跌可能引發借錢買股的投資人進一步被迫賣出。
因此，他們建議投資人保持耐心，直到有明確證據顯示情況已經穩定下來。
